observed2330.interpretation: On every candidate the fix was built for, adding sharesBlock to eligibility was sufficient on its own: score-ordered greedy reached a complete valid set with no backtracking. The backtracking did NOT cause the 2330/2330 result.

conclusion: sharesBlock eligibility is the causal mechanism for the 2330 observed cases. Bounded backtracking is a safety net for configurations that are possible but were not observed in that sample; test B gives it independent controlled coverage.
